verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It establishes the endpoint-parity property for trails, uses finiteness and even vertex degrees to show a longest trail is closed, uses connectedness to locate an unused edge incident with that trail if any edge is omitted, constructs a nonempty closed trail in the even-degree residual graph, and splices the two edge-disjoint closed trails to contradict maximality. All hypotheses are used, and there are no prohibited or unverifiable citations.
